scope: Actual public WoW addon artwork, inspected as images. Proposal-only; no runtime files changed.
excluded: GoldpawsStuff/DiabolicUI media explicitly restricted and excluded. Spartan DataBar-Card.png are screenshot preview cards with baked text and excluded from compositions.

repositories.notice: Root license and README inspected; no explicit media/art exclusion there. Preserve MPL notices for original/adapted files and source availability. Classic art is credited by original SpartanUI website to Atriace; individual inherited game-art ownership is not established solely by root software license.

Root MIT credits Lars Norberg2017; README says original author galaxy119. No explicit media exclusion in this pinned license. Game-derived Diablo artwork stays game-derived; do not claim newly authored MIT ownership.
Current renamed original galaxy119 source pinned; same media family as Ricky mirror, not counted as separate art.
